content: 1 A song of high degrees. When I was in trouble I called vpon God: and he hearde me. 2 Deliuer my soule O God from false lyppes: & from a deceiptful tongue. 3 What doth a deceiptfull tongue vnto thee? what good bryngeth it thee? 4 So much as sharpe arrowes of a strong man in thy sydes: with Iuniper coales powred on thy head. 5 Wo be vnto me that am constrayned to be conuersaunt in Mesech: and to dwell among the tentes of Cedar. 6 My soule hath dwelt long: with hym that hateth peace. 7 I am a man of peace: but because I do speake therof, they prepare them selues to battayle.
